SELECT log_entry.id AS id, log_entry.task_id AS task_id, log_entry.action AS action,
log_entry.from_assignee_user_id AS from_assignee_user_id, from_user.username AS from_assignee_username,
log_entry.to_assignee_user_id AS to_assignee_user_id, to_user.username AS to_assignee_username,
log_entry.assigned_by_user_id AS assigned_by_user_id, operator_user.username AS assigned_by_username,
log_entry.reason AS reason, log_entry.create_time AS create_time FROM task_assignment_log log_entry LEFT JOIN `user` from_user ON from_user.id = log_entry.from_assignee_user_id AND from_user.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN `user` to_user ON to_user.id = log_entry.to_assignee_user_id AND to_user.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN `user` operator_user ON operator_user.id = log_entry.assigned_by_user_id AND operator_user.is_delete = 0 WHERE log_entry.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY log_entry.create_time DESC, log_entry.id DESC
